overall.status: Provisional editorial assessment; not an owner-assigned grade or calculated average.

areas.assessment: A small placeholder image made to show while the game loads.
areas.next: Choose and implement an intentional logo, a short fan-game disclaimer, or a combination; verify readability and startup presentation.
areas.label: score:splash

areas.assessment: The style works; the already-up-to-date case does not.
areas.next: Make current assets a clear, quick success path; verify fresh download, cached assets and recovery.
areas.label: score:asset-sync

areas.assessment: Liked overall, but pixelated compared with the original Three.js mock.
areas.next: Compare the same framing at target resolutions and fix the source of pixelation.
areas.label: score:title

areas.assessment: Faithful to the game and good overall; a few small improvements remain.
areas.next: Preserve the current quality while addressing specific playtest observations.
areas.label: score:character

areas.assessment: Presentation exceeds the original in places, but some angles break down. Principal’s office needs a final pass.
areas.next: Inspect multiple camera angles and finish the principal’s office.
areas.label: score:city

areas.assessment: Better than the original overall, but pixelated and still improvable.
areas.next: Verify crisp rendering, readability and layout at supported resolutions.
areas.label: score:hud

areas.assessment: Playable from start to finish; much of the early effort went here, but a return pass is needed.
areas.next: Replay the story, recording progression, routing, encounter and presentation defects.
areas.label: score:quests

areas.assessment: Close to the original’s feature set; needs substantial playtesting and object-placement polish. Wetlands floors/routing can trap the player.
areas.next: Fix Wetlands stuck routes, then test traps, objects and traversal across room variations.
areas.label: score:free-roam

areas.assessment: Partially implemented: bear/needle and placeable trap textures render incorrectly; player and field traps need timing, radius and status validation. Free-roam layouts and trap visibility also remain incomplete.
areas.next: Fix materials; validate arming, timing, radius and status payloads for player/field traps; verify authored layout placement. Ensure CAST trap visibility and a usable Trap Vision item that lets non-CASTs see and target traps.
areas.label: score:traps

areas.assessment: Mostly placeholders and deliberately deferred. Recover original behavior from psz-re where possible, while separating deliberate new encounter design from fidelity work.
areas.next: Add Snowfield and Makara bosses; make Mother Brain the Arca Plant boss (including necessary level changes), Dark Falz the Dark Shrine boss with a richer form progression, and Blade/Force/Shot Mother Eternal Tower bosses rather than ordinary enemies. Resolve internal identity mappings before implementation.
areas.label: score:bosses

areas.assessment: Basic mechanics exist; lock-on and better enemy behavior are still needed.
areas.next: Specify lock-on, validate enemy families and review attack rhythm, hit alignment and recovery in play.
areas.label: score:combat

areas.assessment: Very weak in current play: Kion reports level-1 hits around 100 damage and routine one-shots, with no meaningful player or enemy-level progression. Damage, statuses, weapon specials and grinding have been deferred.
areas.next: Establish a meaningful level-1 baseline, player growth and quest/free-roam enemy levels. Design a western-punk weapon economy around crafted iron weapons and restored ancient photon weapons; then validate damage, grinding and special/status effects.
